title: Audit bundles and briefcase verify
one_line: Hand an auditor one file that proves which decisions were recorded, unaltered.
verified_against: End to end in a temp HOME: keygen, capture via briefcase.observe('chain:...'), verify, bundle create/verify, and tampering with the store and the bundle (output in docs/features/audit-bundle.md). Commands were run through each module's register() because CLI auto-discovery is built by another work package. Bundle verification also tested with neither PyNaCl nor the compiled core (pure-Python RFC 8032 fallback). No external auditor tooling was used.
